title: U.S. Naval Undersea Museum

services.name: Exhibit Tour
services.desc: Connect with members of the U.S. Submarine Force, past and present! This inside look at the submarine community explores how submarine service shapes those who serve, from qualifying and deployments through retirement and beyond. Step inside a submarine control room, learn how Navy-trained dolphins protect sailors, and explore undersea weapons like torpedoes, mines, and missiles! Learn about the long-term and temporary exhibits currently on display. Connect with undersea history before you even step foot inside the museum! Learn about our outdoor artifacts on exhibit outside the museum. This website is operated by the Naval Undersea Museum Foundation, a private 501 (c) 3 non-profit

services.name: Virtual Programs
services.desc: STEM activities are available for use in the classroom or at home! Multiple STEM-based lessons are available online and can be printed out wherever learners may be. These lessons cover a variety of concepts and can be taught using basic materials found in your own home. This website is operated by the Naval Undersea Museum Foundation, a private 501 (c) 3 non-profit organization chartered to support the U.S. Naval Undersea Museum, an official Navy museum.
